svg.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
svg.title: Tinker Tree
svg.desc: A crooked brass pipe tree grows from a workbench, trunk at left, four branches to the right: Aim, Fort, Crew, Kit. 36 nodes at launch, one fork per branch.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
Nunito, Fredoka, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Aim, Fort, Crew, Kit. 36 nodes at launch, 9 per branch in three tiers, one fork per branch. Node names follow 02-tech-tree. The launch tree is two phone screens wide.

text.font-family: Fredoka, 'Baloo 2', Nunito, 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif
Nunito, Fredoka, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

svg.text: Place Pennants. Take them back any time for free.
